what: RECORDING: a land battle fought by the computer on both sides for the 3D scene to replay (Tools/land_record). Not a booked result: no campaign reads it. Men are tracks (kept points [t, x, y, f] and changes [t, pose, cover, aimX, aimY, hidden, buttoned]); rounds and events each once; blocks every battle second.
title: The hedgerows before Le Mesnil

lines: Their army broke after three minutes of fighting.
Their army broke when it had lost about 18% of its men along the whole line, as much as a defence will pay before it gives up the ground, though most of it was still steady.
In all, the attack lost about 12% of its strength, the defence about 22%.
